name: ink-wash
title: Chinese ink wash
summary: Xieyi ink painting on rice paper, painted while you watch: blank paper is space, one brushstroke is a mountain, a wave, a gesture or a cut.

look.ground: warm procedural rice paper (about #F2ECDE), 60-80 % of every frame left empty

palette.where: the seal and at most one tiny accent in the story

look.type: inscriptions: Cormorant Garamond italic in ink colour, no box, in each shot's empty paper; titles written vertically on the painting with a code-drawn seal
look.texture: paper fibres and flecks; ink bleed, edge pigment and granulation on wet strokes; flying white on dry ones
look.light: none: depth by value, far pale and soft, near dark and textured
look.materials: loaded brushstrokes whose dark edge is the contour, wet washes, dry bristle tracks; no outlines, no flat fills

consistency: xieyi figures from one pale mass and two loaded strokes; strokes seeded by index so they never crawl

motion.feel: painted into existence: stillness, then one stroke crosses the frame in a few frames
moves: right-to-left handscroll pan through one long painting
ink-bloom transition: the next scene grows inside a spreading drop
flying-white stroke out of a silence

pace.text: few calm lines like colophons, at most two lines, held at least max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s)

banned: colour washes other than the one vermilion
red type or a red wash
a busy frame (remove ink rather than add tone)

made_with.renderer: 2D canvas brush engine with a WebGL rice-paper compositor

source: LemoLab's Chinese Ink Wash style in lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar at 9eb7739; pace measured with analyze.py and events.py on its demo film "The Swordsman and the River"
